_doc: Every permission difference between agents-v0.json (the original boilerplate) and the resolved agents must be listed here with a reason. Resources are fnmatch globs over the probed resource strings. Reviewed in Phase 8.

changes.reason: `opencode run --auto` approves `ask`, so unattended runs would read secrets. .env files are denied; .env.example stays readable.
The architect now writes plan.md, tasks and manifest under .ateam/work/ (v0 could not write its own equipe/etapes output).
The legacy equipe/ layout is replaced by .ateam/work/ (migrate-legacy archives it).
Narrow grants: work init, new-task, sync, validate, graph, split, status and quality detect only; completion and gate commands stay denied.
Per-agent skill allowlists: only the skills an agent needs are advertised to it.
Chef starts the deterministic driver (run, status) and keeps the documented fallback commands (work next/start/gate/fail/complete) for when the driver cannot start.
English agent ids replace the French ones.

French aliases stay installed for one release for direct use; the chef delegates to the English ids.

The coder cannot edit its own task, gate configuration or runtime state; only its report under .ateam/work/*/reports/ stays writable.
The coder cannot edit agents, scripts, skills or policy.
plan.md and manifest.json are not part of the coder's context (task files are the interface).
The coder may only run quality, work validate, feedback note and knowledge note; it cannot complete tasks or run gates.
The reviewer writes review files under .ateam/work/*/reviews/ (replaces equipe/REVUE.md).
